caption: The drawing features two textile-like rectangular objects placed vertically on a plain off-white background. The upper object is a small rectangle bordered with a golden-brown patterned edge, enclosing a white field adorned with a single pink flower with a red center and four green leaves, depicted in a symmetrical style. Below it, the lower object is a larger square, also bordered with a similar golden-brown patterned frame. Inside the white area of this square, there is a central pink flower with a yellow center, surrounded by four smaller pink flowers at the corners, all connected by green stems and multiple green leaves radiating outward. At the bottom center of the square textile, there is a small yellow cross. Both pieces have a stitched or embroidered appearance. In the lower right, there is a red inscription that reads "Rumyana Blatey."
title: Burse and Chalice Veil
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
